sources.name: Maquinas de Pump It Up en Argentina (Google My Maps)
sources.example_data_quote: Ultima Rhythm Games (Zeta Haus): Pump It Up PHOENIX 2 2026 Gabinete DX con pantalla LCD Plataforma adaptada a TX Online INFO SOBRE RESERVAS: $6000 la hora (por 1 persona). Neverland Park @ Abasto: PIU PHOENIX 2024 Gabinetes LX ... $2200ARS / 3 Canciones. Sacoa @ Dot Baires (RONDA): PUMP IT UP PRIME 2 2018 Gabinete LX Offline. Daigo House: Pump It Up XSANITY / Resident / RISE / Extra $4000 por hora.
sources.adds_over_current: Current map has 94 Argentina venues from ZIv; 41 are other-only. This community map has ~80 PIU pins with version/cabinet/price/online status that ZIv often lacks or has stale (e.g. Centerplay still lists EXTRA/Zero; Neverland Abasto has PIU Phoenix 2024 detail here). Adds private studios not in arcades.json: Ultima Rhythm Games, PIU Haus (Dabo's), Daigo House, Ciudad Deportiva FORNIX, Rothar Bar. KML export works: https://www.google.com/maps/d/kml?mid=1eda9AYb9wItgLaMZdawcjawkOOY1Jw35&forcekml=1. Shared from Facebook group Pump it up - Argentina (2026-06).
sources.note: Best structured LATAM find. PIU-only (not multi-game cab wiki). Descriptions are rich Spanish text + photos. Machine_readable: KML/KMZ download (treat as api-style export). Hours present on some private studios via reservation links; mall pins often price/version only. Not a full multi-game arcade wiki like hkarcade.

sources.name: Pumps do Brasil (Google My Maps via PIUeSport)
sources.example_data_quote: Shopping Morumbi: Versoes: Fiesta EX e 2 Pump it Up PRO Gabinetes: TX, SX modificada e FX. Lords Diversoes Inteligentes: Versao: Prime Gabinetes: FX. Parque Shopping Barueri: Versao: NX Gabinete: SD. Shopping Campo Limpo: Versao: Fiesta.
sources.adds_over_current: Map has 69 Brazil venues (17 other-only). This My Map has 171 PIU pins nationwide with version/cab type, far denser than current ZIv coverage. Some pins may match existing HotZone/Game Station entries with more cab-version detail; many shopping-mall pins are likely net-new or other-only upgrades. Compare: HotZone MorumbiShopping already has pump_it_up+taiko+notes listing Pump It Up Phoenix; the My Map text for Morumbi is older (Fiesta EX/2 PRO) so treat as seed not truth for current version.
sources.note: Documented on https://piuesport.wordpress.com/2019/07/05/projeto-pumps-do-brasil-via-google-mapas/ (blog still up). KML export works today (~182KB, 171 placemarks). Version histogram is heavily Fiesta/Prime/NX-era with only a handful of XX and almost no Phoenix: data is LIVE but largely STALE. Use as discovery seed for missing venues, not as authoritative machine list. 2025 YouTube 'Ache os Lugares onde tem Pump It Up no Brasil' is a one-off video, not a database.

sources.name: Pump It Up MX - Locales verificados
sources.example_data_quote: La Flechita - Pump It Up CDMX: Ezequiel Ordonez 1, Copilco el Alto, Coyoacan 04360; 2 gabinetes FX+DX MK10 / PIU Phoenix 2; $80/hr individual $120 pareja; 9AM-10PM daily; WhatsApp +52 56 6942 8394. Pineda's Games: Calle Tierra Blanca 333 A, Azcapotzalco; 4 machines (Phoenix/XX/Prime 2/Fiesta 2); $60/juego; 12:00-22:00.
sources.adds_over_current: Map has 91 Mexico venues. La Flechita is NOT in arcades.json at all (dedicated PIU studio with full cab/price/hours). Pineda's Games also missing. The Lost Cave and Phoenix Arcades already exist as pump_it_up-only ZIv stubs without version/price/hours that this site adds. Directory claims LATAM coverage but only Mexico has venues (AR/CL/CO/PE/BR show 0).
sources.note: Quality is mixed. La Flechita (own subdomain, real photos, booking bot) and Pineda's Games (Setmore booking, Instagram @pinedasgames, version list) look real. Several other directory cards use Unsplash stock photos and placeholder phones (e.g. +52 55 0000-0000); treat non-primary entries as unverified until cross-checked. Site also hosts PIU song wiki and Liga Potosina; venue value is the /locales directory + per-venue pages. html_scrape of /locales/ and /locales/venue-*.

sources.name: Playland Park Argentina - Locales
sources.example_data_quote: DEVOTO SHOPPING: Jose Pedro Varela 4866, Piso 3, CP: 1417, CABA. BELGRANO: Monroe 1655, Piso 1, CP: 1428. CANNING: Formosa y Ruta 52 Nro. 653, Local 2018. UNICENTER SHOPPING: Parana 3745, Piso 3, Martinez. Also branches in Mar del Plata, Neuquen, Ushuaia, Mendoza, etc.
sources.adds_over_current: Official multi-branch address list for a large AR family-entertainment chain that often hosts PIU (community AR map lists several Playland Park @ shopping locations with PIU versions). Locator itself has NO games/cabinets. Useful only to seed/merge addresses against ZIv Playland entries or the Argentina PIU My Map.
sources.note: Chain locator only. No per-venue machine list. Do not treat as rhythm-game authority. Related brands (Sacoa, Neverland, Centerplay) appear on the Argentina My Map with better PIU detail.

sources.name: Coney Park Chile - Nuestros Parques
sources.example_data_quote: Filter by city: Antofagasta 1, Calama 1, Coquimbo 1, Los Andes 1, Quilpue 1, San Antonio 1, Santiago 10, Valparaiso 2. Attraction tags include Juegos Arcade but no machine names.
sources.adds_over_current: Chile has 94 venues, 53 other-only. Coney Park branches already partially present in arcades.json (e.g. Coney Park La Fabrica Patio Outlet with pump_it_up; several other Coney Park rows are other-only). Locator can complete branch list but does NOT list PIU/DDR/cabs.
sources.note: Official family-park locator. No per-venue music-game inventory. Low priority vs community PIU maps. Peru also has Coney Park venues in arcades.json; Chile site is Chile-focused.

summary: Searched in es/pt for fliperama, locales PIU, mapa Pump It Up, cadenas (Recorcholis, Coney Park, Playland, Sacoa, Game Station, HotZone), community Facebook groups, and Andamiro/AM.Pass location tools. Latin America is PIU-heavy; no multi-game cab wiki equivalent to hkarcade.fandom.com was found. Best finds: (1) Argentina Google My Map mid=1eda9AYb9wItgLaMZdawcjawkOOY1Jw35 with ~80 pins and current Phoenix 2 / price / cab text, KML exportable; (2) Brazil Pumps do Brasil My Map mid=zUyuXgpU_iIA.kNV4v-UQQeL4 with 171 pins and version fields but largely stale pre-Phoenix data; (3) pumpitup.com.mx verified-locales directory (12 MX, La Flechita + Pineda not in current map). Official chain pages (Playland AR, Coney Park CL, Recorcholis MX) list branches without music-game lineups. No dedicated structured multi-venue game databases found for Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay, Central America, Venezuela, Ecuador, Bolivia, Paraguay, or Panama beyond ZIv and Facebook discussion groups. Compared examples against data/arcades.json: La Flechita/Pineda/Ultima Rhythm/Daigo House absent; many AR Neverland/Sacoa/Centerplay rows need version refresh from the AR My Map.
dead_ends: Recorcholis (recorcholis.com.mx): live family chain, 'encuentra sucursal' UX but no public per-venue machine list or scrapable store API found; only generic attractions. Andamiro piugame.com / AM.Pass: no public global arcade locator. Facebook groups Pump it up - Argentina, Pump It Up - Mexico, Comunidad Pump It Up Chile: active discussion only; the AR group points to the My Map already reported; no pinned multi-venue structured wiki. YouTube 'Ache os Lugares onde tem Pump It Up no Brasil - Atualizado 2025': video essay, not machine-readable. Reddit r/riodejaneiro and r/BuenosAires PIU threads: one-off asks, no maintained list. adb.arcadeitalia.net / vgmaps: not venue databases. ZIv already ingested. No live multi-game LATAM fandom wiki found.
